content.thinking: A syntax error in test E: I have `{"events": [ {...}, {...}]]` — mismatched brackets. Let me fix: it should be `{"events": [ {...}, {...} ]}`. Let me patch that line.

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('scenarios.py').read()
bad='''       {"events": [{"type": "decision", "flow": 2, "class": 2, "reason": "end", "at": 0, "time": 1, "rule": None},
                   {"type": "closed", "flow": 2, "packets": 0, "matches": 0, "class": 2, "reason": "end", "rule": None}]]'''
good='''       {"events": [{"type": "decision", "flow": 2, "class": 2, "reason": "end", "at": 0, "time": 1, "rule": None},
                   {"type": "closed", "flow": 2, "packets": 0, "matches": 0, "class": 2, "reason": "end", "rule": None}]}]'''
assert bad in s
s=s.replace(bad,good)
open('scenarios.py','w').write(s)
EOF
cd /app/tmp/work && timeout 300 python3 scenarios.py 2>&1 | tail -30
